samples.summary: Context menu Cut/Copy stay hidden for a click-selected image — the new image clipboard path is unreachable from the menu
samples.evidence: `docs-context-menu.tsx:74` computes `const hasSelection = !!editor.getActiveSelection();`, and `:176` / `:181` gate `showCut`/`showCopy` on it. `getActiveSelection` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3191) reports only the text `Selection`; the click-selected image lives in the separate `selectedImage` state (editor.ts:1239, exposed as `getSelectedImage()` at :3652), and `selectImageAt`/`handleImageMouseDown` explicitly clear the text range (`selection.setRange(null)`, editor.ts:2507, :3643). So with only an image selected, `hasSelection` is false and neither Cut nor Copy is rendered, even though ⌘C/⌘X now work for exactly that state (text-editor.ts:1193, :1226). This PR already edited this file for the read-only Copy rule, and left the image case out of step with the keyboard path.

samples.summary: Cut deletes at a possibly stale `selectedImage.offset`; a concurrent remote edit can make it remove the wrong inline
samples.evidence: `handleCut`'s new image branch (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:1230) calls `imageDeleteHandler` → `deleteSelectedImageInline` (editor.ts:2242), which does `doc.deleteText({ blockId, offset }, 1)` using the offset captured at click time (set at editor.ts:2508 / :3644). Nothing in the editor re-anchors or clears `selectedImage` when a remote peer edits the block — `restoreLocalCursor` (editor.ts:3724) re-anchors only the caret and the text range, and `dispose` (:3762) is the only other reset. `imageSelectionProvider` (:2256) only checks that *some* image sits at that offset, so a remote insertion that shifts a different image into the slot makes cut copy and delete the wrong image. The pre-existing Delete/Backspace path shares the flaw, but cut is a newly reachable route to it on this branch.

samples.summary: `EditorAPI.cut()`/`copy()` drive `document.execCommand` on an always-empty hidden textarea, so the new image clipboard branch may never be invoked from non-keyboard callers
samples.evidence: `editor.ts:3338`/`:3342` focus the hidden textarea and call `document.execCommand('copy'|'cut')`. The textarea's value is unconditionally cleared (`packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:669`, :746, :758, :763, :794) and nothing ever calls `select()`/`setSelectionRange` (grep found no hits in packages/docs/src), so there is no native selection for the command to act on; browsers commonly refuse to fire the clipboard event in that case. Every consumer of these methods (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-context-menu.tsx:229, :239) therefore depends on behaviour the docs vitest suite only simulates by dispatching synthetic events. Verifying would need a real-browser check that `execCommand('cut')` on the empty textarea reaches `handleCut`.

verdict.reason: All claimed code exists as described. text-editor.ts:1226-1231 routes cut through imageSelectionProvider + imageDeleteHandler; editor.ts:2242-2252 deletes exactly one char at the click-time offset with no identity re-validation; editor.ts:2256-2267 only checks that *some* image sits at that offset. selectedImage (editor.ts:1239) is set at :2508/:3644 and never re-anchored on remote change: restoreLocalCursor (:3724-3738) re-anchors only caret + text range, validateCursorPosition (:979-987) only fixes a vanished cursor block, and the sole remote-change entry point (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-view.tsx:378-394) calls refresh/restoreLocalCursor/validateCursorPosition/render without touching selectedImage. No guard elsewhere makes the stale-offset path unreachable, so a concurrent remote insertion that shifts a different image into the slot causes cut to copy and delete the wrong inline. In-lane as an invariant other modules (the collab re-anchoring layer) fail to maintain, with data-loss impact on a reachable path.
